* Overview: Painting at the Temple of the Emerald Buddha, Bangkok, depicting characters or scenes from Rammakian, a Thai version of the Hindu epic poem Rāmāyaṇa.
Characters/scenes depicted: Ninlaphat (นิลพัท), a monkey soldier, gets a medical pestle from the serpent king of the underworld.
